title: human_decision_recorded event payload
$comment: Class: REQUIRES_SPEC_ID. Schema-first record of an operator/human judgment. HUMAN-DECISION-EVIDENCE-001: provenance, never authority — this event documents a human decision; it does not confer scope authority, bypass a gate/waiver/guard, or change ownership/lifecycle state.

decision.description: Short machine-readable predicate of what the human decided (e.g. 'approve-approach', 'authorize-takeover', 'resolve-blocker').

decision_class.description: Closed classification of the decision type.

rationale.description: Optional human-written reason. Narrative goes here, never as an untyped catch-all field.

record.description: Optional reference to the related record: waiver id, spec id, ac id, reprieve id, or decision artifact.

subject_paths.description: Optional paths the decision concerns (e.g. for provenance/redaction surface).
